support=[];used=set();unknown=[];usedmonths=set()

 reconstructed=d[(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&d.valid_features].idx.astype(int).tolist()
 assert reconstructed==members,(i,'未读标签成熟成员与原保存身份不同')

 clock=(oc.to_numpy()==nc.to_numpy())&pd.notna(nc).to_numpy()&(nc.to_numpy()<=pd.to_datetime(test.decision_time,utc=True).to_numpy())
 order=np.isclose(test['manufacturing_new_orders_identity'].to_numpy(float)-50,test['订单水平'].to_numpy(float),rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
